questionText:
which word fills the blank in this research-library passage?

embryo freezing is an established fertility preservation option.
egg freezing is an established fertility preservation option.
ovarian tissue freezing may be considered in selected cases.
ovarian suppression with medications may be used for some patients during chemotherapy.
ovarian suppression is not a replacement for egg or embryo freezing when those are possible.
some breast cancer patients may use stimulation protocols designed to reduce estrogen exposure.
treatment should not be dangerously delayed for fertility preservation.
urgent cancer care may limit available options.
fertility preservation counseling can still help people understand future paths.
after chemotherapy: what can be checked
after treatment, _____ health care can help clarify what changed and what options remain.
menstrual history can show whether cycles returned.
